title: 50 Years of Music Synthesis
summary: Georgia Tech lecture series introducing the course "Analog Circuits for Music Synthesis": the analog ancestors, the arrival of microprocessors, sampling, and where synthesis is heading, plus why solid EE design fundamentals matter for synth circuits.
